description: Run one symmetric long/short scan over the same top-volume universe and return rule-independent breadth, 24h liquidity semantics and ranked directional candidates. Use this first for comprehensive day-trade or scalp discovery; then deep-dive only the shortlist with derivatives/order-flow tools. A low match count is never reported as breadth.

limitPerSide.description: Candidates returned per direction. Default 10, max 25.

right.description: A number, or another operand in the same form as left.

manualSymbols.description: Optional symbols forced into the universe before current-volume ranking.

market.description: Defaults to the chart. Perpetuals are futures.
